name: After § 3
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Georgia
part_text: 3a. Notes that the October 2024 parliamentary elections were conducted within the constitutional framework of Georgia and led to the formation of a government reflecting the will of the people of Georgia; encourages all political actors to engage in a constructive, peaceful dialogue within the national legal framework; calls for the EU to respect the democratic choice of the Georgian people; warns that the EU, by supporting efforts to overturn a legitimate election result because of dissatisfaction with the outcome, is undermining democracy in Georgia;
